craft_notes: Sthāyin: vow-purified (hundredfold). Rows: row 2 (sealed→poured). Close: poured (homa as landing). Rejected: 'atonement' — kept penance (prāyaścitta precise); 'sacred fire' gloss — kept fire-turned-Śiva (the transformation IS the rite).

lines: Then let the vow be made pure in fire-turned-Śiva by the common chant;
name coffined in his own chant — 'I cleanse the penance,' svāhā-sealed — a hundred poured.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sādhāraṇamantreṇa śivīkṛte agnau vrataśuddhiṃ kuryāt tanmantrasampuṭaṃ nāma kṛtvā prāyaścittaṃ śodhayāmi iti svāhāntaṃ śataṃ juhuyāt

reads_against.argmap: How is the vow purified? → Vow-mantra dialogue in transformed fire: a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā.
c1_essence: Vow purified in Śiva-made fire: name casketed, a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā.
